{{Quote|We call it the 'Wraith Box,' after the device from the Ajunta Pall legend. It disintegrated three of my men, but the tunnel carvings suggest it grants great power.|Major Gart Charkron|audio=MajorChakron-WraithBox-TOR.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''Wraith Box''' was an ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] artifact with disturbing powers. At some point, it was placed within the vaults of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire's]] prison world of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. The name for this device came from the legends of [[Ajunta Pall]], and the carvings within [[the Tomb]] indicated that the relic was capable of granting its user great power.<ref name="TOR" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Gart Charkron]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] was stationed on Belsavis. He uncovered the existence of the ancient alien device but was not sure how it operated, though he knew it was extremely dangerous and had disintegrated three of his men. Furthermore, he believed some of the prisoners had inadvertently salvaged some of its core components that had been split into three parts. He tasked a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] official with the recovery of the device and reassembling it.<ref name="TOR" />
